say:52:1028450020:0.text: Students, you should've heard of the exclusion edict in the Dark Forest. We have sealed ourselves in and blocked off communication with the outside world because outsiders are deemed dangerous.

say:57:1028450025:0.text: Because that is exactly what it means to exist. It's also the meaning of nature that I want to convey.
